There are many ways of getting to Ponte Organasco, the starting point of the walk:

  • The one we recommend by far is the coach.

    Passenger services run regularly several times a day from Piacenza railway station and are very reliable. See the E17 line timetable here; the line connects Piacenza (railway station and other stops in town) to Ottone, stopping at Ponte Organasco. Sometimes a change of vehicle at Bobbio is required.

    We are working with the transport company Tempi (which coordinates the actual operation of the coaches provided by the company Seta) so that a more frequent connection can be guaranteed. We hope to be able to update you soon with some good news.

  • The alternative to the coach is the car, motorcycle or other motor vehicle, which can indeed be parked free of charge at Ponte Organasco near the start of the path; the problem is that then, once the route is finished, you will have to return to Ponte Organasco to collect the vehicle. Even leaving aside the annoyance of having to leave it unattended for several days, the logistical difficulties you wanted to postpone on the way out will therefore come back on the return. This solution is thus advisable only for those who can get someone else to drive them, or for those who, for reasons of personal organisation, cannot fit in with the coach timetables on the way out but can on the way back.
  • Similar considerations apply, mutatis mutandis, to those who wish to get there by bicycle with the idea of parking it at Ponte Organasco and continuing on foot. Riding the entire Via del Cifalco by bicycle, on the other hand, is possible – provided you have a mountain bike (MTB) and suitable equipment – although we recommend undertaking this journey on foot.

Note that it is possible to start the walk from Cerignale, skipping the first climb from Ponte Organasco. The coach does not go as far as the village (it stops at the turn-off on the Statale, 6 kilometres of tarmac road from the village of Cerignale), [but if you are staying overnight at one of the accommodations in Cerignale you can ask to be picked up by car at this turn-off.
